name: GET /api/empi/metrics - EMPI calibration + unresolved/reversal metrics
description: Returns EMPI quality metrics: probability calibration (expected calibration error over the score bins), the count of unresolved candidate links, and the merge reversal rate. Edge cases: the endpoint takes no parameters and is not tenant-filtered - it reports across the whole EMPI store; with no adjudicated links yet the calibration bins are empty and the ECE/rates come back as zeros rather than erroring; any failure inside getEmpiMetrics is caught and flattened to a bare 500 InternalError with no detail.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in the form "Bearer <jwt>"
JWT signature invalid, malformed, or past its exp claim
the calibration/metrics aggregation throws — caught and returned as a bare InternalError
